description: This file contains utility code for managing launch agents via launchctl. It defines structures for capturing the result of launchctl commands, snapshots of launch agent property lists, and functions to run launchctl commands and parse their associated property list files.

classes.name: Launchctl.Result
classes.description: Holds the output status and output string from running launchctl commands.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a launchctl command with specified arguments and returns the result containing status and output.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Parses a property list file at a given URL to create a snapshot of a launch agent's configuration.
